title: Search provider 1.0
description: Server filter fsinterop.search.providers (RefreshGlobal extension, not in the shared protocol yet): a module that can search tickets in a context, with a GET endpoint answering ?q=&limit= with search results 1.0 for the logged-in user. In the browser, RefreshGlobal offers RefreshGlobalInterop.search(query, limit).

context.description: search context, e.g. global-mailboxes, or * for every context

endpoint.description: GET URL answering ?q=&limit= with search results 1.0, for the logged-in user
